title: MNI Open iEEG Atlas: normal intracranial EEG in wakefulness and sleep (processed 200 Hz atlas clips)
description: A processed derivative release of the MNI Open iEEG Atlas containing artifact-free intracranial EEG (stereo-EEG and subdural strips/grids) at 200 Hz from 106 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy. It provides one minute of normal-appearing activity per vigilance state (wakefulness, N2, N3, REM) and up to 10 minutes of N2 and N3 sleep, with bipolar channels localized in MNI space. The data serve as a normative atlas of physiological intracranial activity across cortical regions.
methods_description: Source authors low-pass filtered at 80 Hz, resampled to 200 Hz, removed power-line interference adaptively, visually rejected artifacts, and concatenated artifact-free segments with zero buffers. Channels are bipolar derivations between adjacent contacts, selected from normal grey-matter tissue outside the seizure onset zone. Arrays were repacked losslessly into BrainVision float32 format.
